```sql
with captures as (
    select
        a.attempt_id,
        a.order_id,
        a.amount_minor,
        a.currency,
        a.business_date,
        case
            when a.business_date between date '2026-09-01' and date '2026-09-09' then 'this_month'
            when a.business_date between date '2026-08-01' and date '2026-08-09' then 'last_month_same_days'
        end as period_key,
        row_number() over (
            partition by a.order_id, a.amount_minor
            order by a.attempt_no, a.attempt_id
        ) as capture_rank
    from payment_attempts a
    join orders o on o.order_id = a.order_id
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    where a.status = 'captured'
      and not a.is_test
      and not o.is_test
      and s.region_id = 'IN-TN'
      and (
          a.business_date between date '2026-09-01' and date '2026-09-09'
          or a.business_date between date '2026-08-01' and date '2026-08-09'
      )
),
totals as (
    select
        c.period_key as key,
        cast(round(sum(c.amount_minor * fx.inr_per_unit)) as bigint) as value
    from captures c
    join fx_rates fx
      on fx.currency = c.currency
     and fx.rate_date = c.business_date
    where c.capture_rank = 1
    group by c.period_key
),
periods as (
    select 'this_month' as key, 1 as sort_order
    union all
    select 'last_month_same_days' as key, 2 as sort_order
)
select
    p.key,
    coalesce(t.value, 0) as value
from periods p
left join totals t on t.key = p.key
order by p.sort_order
```
